definitions.explanation: A written or spoken representation of something; the act of describing or writing about something.

examples.japanese: {詳|くわ}しい{記述|きじゅつ}を{求|もと}める。
{歴史的|れきしてき}な{記述|きじゅつ}によると。
{記述|きじゅつ}{式|しき}の{問題|もんだい}に{答|こた}える。

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {記述|きじゅつ}する: to describe, to write
- {記述|きじゅつ}{式|しき}: essay-type, descriptive (as opposed to multiple choice)
- {詳細|しょうさい}な{記述|きじゅつ}: detailed description

RELATED TERMS:
- {記載|きさい}: description, entry
- {叙述|じょじゅつ}: narration
- {描写|びょうしゃ}: depiction
